headline: Southern New Hampshire outscore every programme in the division
dek: Held at Assumption, Southern New Hampshire still lead the division for goals scored, and no programme in any other conference has put away as many. That standing is the one the draw could not touch.
displaced_by: results night: Southern New Hampshire held at Assumption and still the division's top scorers across every conference
